title: Initiation
text: A UE initiates the procedure   when there is a need inform the network about a failure detected by the UE.    In particular,  the UE initiates the procedure   when the following condition is met:
1 >  upon detecting failure for an RLC bearer, in accordance with 5.3.10.3;
1 >  upon detecting DAPS handover failure, in accordance with 5.3.5.8.3; Upon initiating the procedure,   the UE shall:
1 >  initiate transmission of the FailureInformation message as specified in 5.7.5.3;
